about_the_game:
Nova Jet is a Synthwave survivor-like auto-shooter!

Jump into your JET (Juice Extraction Transport) and embark on an intergalactic employment like no other! As a loyal employee of Nova Cola Drinks Company, your task is simple: Slice, Blast, Shoot and Explode enemies, extract their delicious Juice, and fuel the production of the galaxy's most popular (and most sinister) drink—Nova Cola.

But being a "good employee" isn't just about juice:

  • Upgrade Your JET
    Survive relentless alien waves and unlock powerful weapons and upgrades by playing rounds of Plinko. Customize your JET to dominate the juice-field!

  • Mine for Power-Ups
    Enhance your gameplay with hidden items you can mine for. Mines, Air-Raids, Shields and Health.

  • Collect Juice
    Blast enemy hordes to collect their glowing Juice. It’s a messy job, but someone has to do it. Plus it’s your job anyway.

Can you stay alive long enough to keep the juice flowing, or will you become another casualty in Nova Cola’s corporate machine?

Dive into the fast-paced action of Nova JET.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: 4 core CPU
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970
  • Additional Notes: Does not support Ultra-wide Monitors
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: 6 or 8 core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970
  • Additional Notes: Does not support Ultra-wide Monitors

short_description: Nova JET is a Synthwave survivor-like auto shooter! Pilot your JET (Juice Extraction Transport), Slice, Blast, Shoot and Explode enemies, collect Juice, Mine for power-ups, and Upgrade your JET by playing Plinko. All this for your malevolent employer, Nova Cola drinks company.
